decisions.reason: The offshore vessel management service is close to the established offer and targets growing offshore renewable markets, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept with low drop probability.

Crew and corporate travel management supports essential maritime logistics and builds on the firm's existing services, making satisfactory performance likely and retention consistent with organizational slack.
The online vessel information portal extends the established offer digitally; although its payoff is less certain, the large firm's slack allows it to be carried while performance is evaluated.
The mobile vessel performance app is adjacent to the firm's core services and can enhance quality; given organizational slack and no clear shortfall, it is likely kept.
